terms_intro: Please read these Terms of Service carefully before using Perceptra. By accessing or using our services, you agree to be bound by these terms.
terms_s1_body: By creating an account or accessing the visual search services, APIs, and web interface provided by Perceptra, you agree to comply with and be legally bound by these Terms of Service and all applicable laws and regulations.
terms_s2_body: When you upload visual content to our platform, you grant us permission to process the image data solely for generating vector representations, index embeddings, and delivering similarity queries. You retain complete ownership and intellectual property rights in your original uploaded media.
terms_s3_body: You agree not to use Perceptra to upload unlawful, infringing, abusive, or harmful material. Automated scraping, reverse engineering of proprietary index structures, or attempting to degrade service availability for other users is strictly prohibited.
terms_s4_body: You are responsible for safeguarding your authentication credentials and API keys. Notify us immediately of any unauthorized use or security compromise regarding your account.
terms_s5_body: Perceptra is provided on an 'as is' and 'as available' basis. We make no warranties regarding uninterrupted availability, metric accuracy of nearest-neighbor lookups, or fitness for high-stakes biometric verification.
privacy_intro: Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how Perceptra collects, processes, and protects your information.
privacy_s1_body: We collect information you provide directly (such as your account email address and encrypted password credentials), as well as metadata related to query images and API transactions (timestamps, embedding vector dimensions, and search latencies).
privacy_s2_body: We use collected information to authenticate users, generate high-dimensional image embeddings, perform nearest-neighbor index lookups, diagnose query performance, and ensure platform security.
privacy_s3_body: Uploaded images are temporarily buffered to compute mathematical feature descriptors (vectors). High-dimensional vectors are stored in isolated index partitions associated with your account and are never shared or used to train third-party public models without explicit consent.
privacy_s4_body: You have the right to request deletion of your account, query histories, and associated vector indexes at any time. Upon account deletion, all linked embeddings and session records are permanently purged from active indexing shards.
privacy_s5_body: If you have questions regarding this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your data protection rights, please contact our privacy team at privacy@cbir-studio.local.
